claim: A reduced active-inference choice model with an epistemic expected-free-energy term predicts held-out choices better than a complexity-matched Bayes-optimal reward model in conditions selected before confirmatory data collection.
primary_metric: held-out log predictive density difference: LPD_AIF - LPD_BRL
pass: LPD_AIF - LPD_BRL > 0 on the preregistered confirmatory set
direction replicates in an independent confirmatory sample
fail: LPD_AIF - LPD_BRL <= 0 on the primary confirmatory endpoint
or the no-epistemic ablation performs equally well within the preregistered equivalence margin
unresolved: Models are empirically non-identifiable under simulation/recovery or fall inside a preregistered equivalence region.
development_rule: Search task conditions only on model predictions/simulations, never on confirmatory human data.
confirmatory_rule: Freeze task grid, parameter priors, exclusions, scoring function, and model code hashes before opening confirmatory data.
global_recomposition: A PASS supports this specific discriminative claim only; it does not establish the universal FEP.
